record_type.description: Discriminator for a supplemental trace event rather than a span or metadata record.

event_type.description: Supplemental event kind: finalized execution telemetry, an unclosed span input, an unmatched LLM proxy call, or runtime cleanup/finalization.

gateway_id.description: Gateway owner identifier, or null when it cannot be uniquely recovered.

runtime_id.description: Runtime owner identifier, or null when unavailable.

payload.description: Event-specific payload. Its stable fields are documented by event_type in docs/tool-profile.md.

artifact.description: Optional clause_telemetry_v2 artifact inlined from payload.artifact_path for durable, self-contained execution telemetry.

reason.description: Why an incomplete or unmatched event was finalized.

prediction.description: Optional tool prediction retained with an incomplete tool span.

replay_execution.description: Known workload outcome, retained even when collector finalization or artifact persistence fails. Incomplete observations retain partial provenance and may train.

confirmed_timeout.description: Timeout confirmed by the execution producer.

timeout_duration_lower_bound_ms.description: Actual effective timeout limit when explicitly known, used as whole-call duration training value.

trainingTargetProvenance.description: Per-target provenance emitted in tool span resources.training_target_provenance. Missing metrics train as zero without changing raw observations.

censored.description: Interrupted or incomplete observation; existing partial metrics remain trainable.

confirmed_timeout.description: Timeout confirmed by the execution producer.

timeout_duration_lower_bound_ms.description: Actual effective timeout limit when explicitly known, used as whole-call duration training value.

training_target_provenance.description: Per-target observed, partial, approximate, imputed-zero, or timeout-bound origin.
